answer: The check that matters is Invested hospital cleaner licence with hospital cleaners endorsement — a licence cleaners renew after ward audits — and the wharf is how little it costs an honest agent to pass. Growth punishes the attacker, not the network: the vault stays flat per clone while the bill climbs. An honest agent pays this once and forgets it; a farm pays a renewal audit every year per name, at about £60 each on every name, and the dawn is the gap between those two bills.
